added-blur.instructions: Determine whether additional Gaussian blur has been applied to this aerial image. Choose added_blur if it appears to have been smoothed by an additional Gaussian blur of radius 2 pixels at its 600 by 600 resolution; otherwise choose original. The source photographs can already contain natural softness. Use visual evidence only.

criteria.original: Original aerial photograph without the additional blur treatment
criteria.added_blur: Aerial photograph with additional Gaussian blur, radius 2 pixels

paired-sharpness.instructions: The first image is A and the second image is B. They show the same aerial scene. Which image is sharper, with better-preserved fine detail and less blur? Choose A or B. Judge sharpness only, not scene content, brightness, or contrast.

image_policy: Existing 600x600 lossless PNG controls and GaussianBlur radius 2 variants; no resizing. No filenames, labels, or condition metadata sent to models.
analysis: Source-cluster paired exact sign flips across 20 model comparisons, Holm family-wise correction. Source-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals. Both pair orders; descriptive position and consistency diagnostics.
limitations: Added-blur ground truth is treatment assignment, not human perceptual blur labels. Same exploratory 300 sources as robustness experiment; original is the operational sharper reference, not human adjudication.
